claims: Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are twin brothers.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are sons of Carlos Boozer.
Carlos Boozer is a former Duke and NBA star.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are 2025-26 freshman starters for the Duke Blue Devils.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer helped lead Duke to the 2026 ACC Tournament title.
Cameron Boozer was named ACC Tournament MVP.
According to ESPN, in their home debut in November 2025, Cameron Boozer recorded 25 points and 8 rebounds.
According to ESPN, in their home debut in November 2025, Cayden Boozer recorded 14 points, 7 rebounds, and 5 assists.
Carlos Boozer won a national championship at Duke in 2001.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were top-five-star prospects in the 2025 class.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to coach Jon Scheyer
